notes.title: Landoria Game Development Update #3
notes.content:
Greetings, Adventurers of Landoria!

We are excited to unveil our latest development video, Update #3, showcasing the incredible progress we've made in crafting an immersive and engaging experience for all players. Here's what you can look forward to:

🌍 Major World Visual and Functional Update
Our revamped world brings a fresh, dynamic feel to Landoria! This update introduces improved mechanics centered around territory interactions, delivering a strategic layer to your adventures.

🗺️ New Terrains for Battle Variety
Prepare to face challenges across diverse landscapes! The addition of new terrains enriches your battles, ensuring every encounter feels unique and rewarding.

🏰 Castle Fortification and Territory Expansion
Your heroes now have the power to fortify castles, turning them into central hubs for territory control. Claim tiles around your castles to expand your domain and unlock bonus stats. Strategic planning will be key to success!

🎭 Streamlined Gameplay—Council Scene Removed
We've simplified gameplay by removing the council scene. All actions are now seamlessly integrated into the world scene for a more cohesive experience.

🕵️ Enhanced Quest Framework
We've refined the quest framework to focus on story progression. With its new maturity, quests will unfold in exciting and meaningful ways, drawing you deeper into the lore of Landoria.

📹 Watch Video Update #3 on Steam now and witness the evolution of Landoria firsthand! Your support continue to inspire us as we push forward in bringing this world to life.

Thank you for being part of our journey!
